description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (tree width) and accuracy@1 for two different models. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The first line, representing GPT-4o, is blue with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at (1, 24.4) and increases to (3, 28.9), then continues to increase to a peak at (5, 34.4), before decreasing to (7, 31.1). The second line, representing Claude-3.5-Sonnet, is light blue with cross markers and a solid line style. It starts at (1, 26.7) and increases to (3, 27.8), then decreases to (5, 24.4) and further decreases to (7, 20.0).
